# PDF.js 6.4.299

Vendored legacy browser build from Mozilla pdfjs-dist 6.4.299 (Apache-2.0).
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.4.299.tgz
Registry SHA-512 integrity verified before extraction:
sha512-AVl138zALtfaAPvADulE0PZThbYzCBS79nL4pOSL/6Sm/4AH5A21BD9VHt97OlCuzJuCpmeZtAtkinisF4Vb1g==

Unmodified pdf.min.mjs and pdf.worker.min.mjs are served as pdf.mjs and pdf.worker.mjs.
Includes CMaps, standard fonts and image decoders with their licenses.
Sandbox/scripting assets and QuickJS are excluded: the Hub renders PDF pages to
canvas and does not enable document scripts, actions, forms or embedded links.
SHA256SUMS records checksums of the extracted files.

All assets are served locally; visitors make no request to an npm/CDN provider.
